note: The Phoenix island golden hash (docs/design/WEB_STREAMING.md §3.4, §8 item 6): FNV-1a over every island static box (min/max x z, height, tag; mm) and every building (bounds, enterable, door count), in build order. It guards the RNG sequence in world/city.js: if a change moves anything in Phoenix, this no longer matches and the selftest says so. Re-pin it ONLY for a deliberate change to the island.
ringPlansNote: FNV-1a over the JSON of every planned building of a fresh Phoenix ring (rooms, partitions, doors, walls, furniture, beds, containers), pinned on 1109205b before the island got its floor plans (docs/design/WEB_FLOORPLANS.md 'The island'): the island's plan rows and the shared furniture code must leave the ring's byte for byte. Re-pin it ONLY for a deliberate change to the ring.
p1ChunksNote: Layout hashes of twelve P1 chunks (the island edge, the Phoenix ring, I-10 near Los Angeles and El Paso, exits, open desert) pinned before Florida came in (docs/design/WEB_FLORIDA.md section 5): a region added past P1 must leave every P1 chunk byte for byte. Re-pin ONLY for a deliberate change to P1. Re-pinned 2026-10-23 for one deliberate P1 change: chunk -25,-4 carries L1 water (the Central Arizona Project aqueduct, docs/design/WEB_RIVERS.md); the other eleven are byte for byte.
